decision_reason: The refreshed V29 fold-internal run is a useful 1200-symbol research diagnostic, but it is not a production-qualifying Purged Walk-Forward result. Required universe, PIT, purge/embargo, clean holdout, random-baseline, distribution, robustness, and strategy-bound paper evidence gates are not all satisfied.

findings: The consolidated V44 gate is bound to the failed V40 paper-shadow candidate.
V29 is the latest repaired research line, but it is not an approved or preregistered production artifact.
The V49/V45 daily runner is a fixed 90%-gross equal-weight basket of 518880, 511010, and 511260; it does not execute V40 or V29 stock signals.

limitations: Candidate-level reports are fixed-candidate chronological diagnostics and explicitly valid=false.
The top-level candidate selection is train-only per fold, but has no purge or embargo gap between train and test.
The candidate family was developed using the same historical period and has no preregistered clean future holdout.
The script's built-in research OOS threshold is 0.84; this report applies the stricter production threshold separately.
This run uses only 1200 symbols and free-source V31 trading-status approximations.

full_1565_universe.note: Only 1200 parquet files exist. The available 2000-symbol lists are non-large-cap exclusion universes and cannot replace the required unfiltered universe.

production_pit_data.note: V31 explicitly reports production_data_ready=false; ST, delisting, suspension, price-limit and corporate-action evidence remain approximate or unreconciled.

purge_and_embargo.note: The implementation uses contiguous 756-day train and 252-day test windows with no explicit purge/embargo.

clean_preregistered_holdout.note: The candidate set was developed post-hoc on the historical interval used by this rerun.

actual_candidate_random_baseline.note: No random-baseline evidence is bound to the refreshed top-level V29 candidate-selection return stream. Existing bucket-timing random tests address a different hypothesis.

lookahead_and_label_horizon.note: The five-day rolling-IC label leak was fixed and regression-tested, and selection is train-only, but missing purge/embargo and clean future holdout prevent a production pass.

monthly_annual_and_regime_distribution.note: The refreshed top-level selection report does not contain a production-bound monthly, annual, bull/bear, or tail-period distribution gate.

parameter_and_cost_sensitivity.note: Existing V29 robustness reports use fixed-candidate diagnostics that are now explicitly invalid for W/D gating; the refreshed fold-internal selection has not been rerun under the full sensitivity and double-cost matrix.

recent_90_day_stability.note: The latest comparable V29 robustness evidence reported recent-90 Sharpe near -2.51 and failed robustness.

strategy_bound_90_60_paper_evidence.note: The V49/V45 ledger is generated by a fixed three-ETF paper basket, not by the V40 or V29 strategy; its accumulated days cannot qualify either candidate.

required_next_work: Restore or acquire lianghua-owned unfiltered 1565-symbol historical data and build a hash-bound production-grade PIT/trading-status/corporate-action manifest.
Freeze and preregister one candidate family before observing a new holdout period.
Implement explicit purge/embargo and bind random-baseline, monthly/annual/regime, parameter, and cost-stress gates to the same fold-internal OOS return stream.
Replace the fixed three-ETF V49/V45 runner with a paper runner that executes the frozen candidate's actual signals; restart the 90-calendar-day/60-report-day clock from that freeze.
